SELECT /* SQL-ID: isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.workChgAplylMapper.selectWorkListFrom */ (SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(SCA100.FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 , SAA200 WHERE DD.USER_ID = SAA200.USER_ID AND SAA200.ENFSN_NO = SCA100.ENFSN_NO ) AS FLNM , DD.WORK_YMD || ', ' || MM.BGNG_HR || ' ~ ' || MM.END_HR AS WORKER_FROM , DD.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN AS TASKWK_SCHDL_SN_FROM , DD.USER_ID AS ID_FROM , MM.BGNG_HR || ' ~ ' || MM.END_HR AS TIME_FROM , DD.WORK_YMD AS WORK_YMD_FROM , MM.BGNG_HR AS BGNG_HR_FROM , MM.END_HR AS END_HR_FROM , ROWNUM AS RN FROM AYC110 MM , AYC100 DD WHERE MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO
AND DD.WORK_YMD = #{WORKYMD} AND DD.TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND DD.USER_ID = #{USERID}

SELECT INDEX_SN AS INDEXSN , ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 , SCA100 WHERE 1=1 AND SAA200.USER_ID = CHG_DMND_ID AND SCA100.ENFSN_NO = SAA200.ENFSN_NO ) AS CHG_DMND_NM , CHG_DMND_ID AS CHG_DMND_ID , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CHG_DMND_WORK_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '(' || CHG_DMND_WORK_HR_CN ||')' AS CHG_DMND_WORK_YMD , ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 , SCA100 WHERE 1=1 AND SAA200.USER_ID = CHG_TRGT_ID AND SCA100.ENFSN_NO = SAA200.ENFSN_NO ) AS CHG_TRGT_NM , CHG_TRGT_ID AS CHG_TRGT_ID , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CHG_TRGT_WORK_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '(' || CHG_TRGT_WORK_HR_CN ||')' AS CHG_TRGT_WORK_YMD , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'APRV_STTS_SE_CD' AND AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AYC140.APRV_STTS_SE_CD ) AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD , TO_CHAR(AYC140.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM AYC140 WHERE CHG_DMND_ID = #{CHGDMNDID} ORDER BY INDEX_SN DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT AA.INDEX_SN AS INDEXSN , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.CHG_DMND_WORK_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DMND_YMD , CHG_DMND_ID AS CHG_DMND_ID , ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 , SCA100 WHERE 1=1 AND SAA200.USER_ID = AA.CHG_DMND_ID AND SCA100.ENFSN_NO = SAA200.ENFSN_NO ) AS CHG_DMND_NM , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.CHG_DMND_WORK_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '(' || AA.CHG_DMND_WORK_HR_CN ||')' AS CHG_DMND_WORK_YMD , AA.CHG_DMND_WORK_HR_CN AS CHG_DMND_WORK_HR_CN , AA.CHG_DMND_SN AS CHG_DMND_SN , AA.CHG_TRGT_ID AS CHG_TRGT_ID , ( SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SAA200 , SCA100 WHERE 1=1 AND SAA200.USER_ID = AA.CHG_TRGT_ID AND SCA100.ENFSN_NO = SAA200.ENFSN_NO ) AS CHG_TRGT_NM , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(AA.CHG_TRGT_WORK_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '(' || AA.CHG_TRGT_WORK_HR_CN ||')' AS CHG_TRGT_WORK_YMD , AA.CHG_TRGT_WORK_HR_CN AS CHG_TRGT_WORK_HR_CN , AA.CHG_TRGT_SN AS CHG_TRGT_SN , AA.CHG_CS_CN AS CHG_CS_CN , AA.APRV_STTS_SE_CD AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD , ( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 BB WHERE 1=1 AND BB.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'APRV_STTS_SE_CD' AND BB.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.APRV_STTS_SE_CD ) AS APRV_STTS_SE_NM , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT FROM AYC140 AA /* 근무변경허가원 */ WHERE 1=1 AND AA.INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}

/* * isry.couns.taskwkschmng.schprecon.mapper.workChgAplylMapper.selectWorkChgAplyChkList */
/* 신청자이전휴게시간 : 대상자의 근무시작시간 - 신청자의 대상근무일자이전 근무종료시간 */ SELECT 'CHG_DMND_BEFORE' AS RET_TITLE , TRUNC( ( TO_DATE(#{CHG_TRGT_YMD} || REPLACE(#{CHG_TRGT_BGNG_HR}, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') /* 대상_시작시간 : 신청자가 선택한 대상자의 시작 시간 */ - CASE /* 신청자의 이전근무 종료시간 */ WHEN SUBSTR(BGNG_HR, 0, 2) < '20' THEN TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(EE.END_HR, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(EE.END_HR, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 END ) * 24, 0 ) AS RET_VAL FROM ( SELECT MM.BGNG_HR , MM.END_HR , DD.WORK_YMD FROM AYC110 MM , AYC100 DD WHERE 1=1 AND MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND DD.USER_ID = #{CHG_DMND_ID} AND DD.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN <> #{CHG_DMND_SN} -- 요청_업무일정일렬번호 AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(DD.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(MM.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{CHG_TRGT_YMD} || REPLACE(#{CHG_TRGT_BGNG_HR}, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY DD.WORK_YMD DESC, SUBSTR(MM.BGNG_HR,0,2) DESC ) EE WHERE ROWNUM = 1 UNION ALL /* 신청자이후휴게시간 : 신청자의 대상근무일자이후 근무시작시간 - 대상자의 근무종료시간 */ SELECT 'CHG_DMND_AFTER' AS RET_TITLE , TRUNC( ( TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(EE.BGNG_HR, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') /* 신청자의 이후근무 시작시간 */ - CASE /* 대상_시작시간 : 신청자가 선택한 대상자의 시작 시간 → 대상_종료시간으로 변경 */ WHEN SUBSTR(#{CHG_TRGT_BGNG_HR}, 0, 2) < '20' THEN TO_DATE(#{CHG_TRGT_YMD} || REPLACE(#{CHG_TRGT_END_HR}, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE TO_DATE(#{CHG_TRGT_YMD} || REPLACE(#{CHG_TRGT_END_HR}, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 END ) * 24, 0 ) AS RET_VAL FROM ( SELECT MM.BGNG_HR , DD.WORK_YMD , DD.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN FROM AYC110 MM , AYC100 DD WHERE 1=1 AND MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND DD.USER_ID = #{CHG_DMND_ID} AND DD.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN <> #{CHG_DMND_SN} /* 요청_업무일정일렬번호 */ AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(DD.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(MM.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{CHG_TRGT_YMD} || REPLACE(#{CHG_TRGT_BGNG_HR}, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY DD.WORK_YMD ASC, SUBSTR(MM.BGNG_HR,0,2) ASC ) EE WHERE ROWNUM = 1 UNION ALL /* 대상자이전휴게시간 */ SELECT 'CHG_TRGT_BEFORE' AS RET_TITLE , TRUNC( ( TO_DATE(#{CHG_DMND_YMD} || REPLACE(#{CHG_DMND_BGNG_HR}, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') /* 요청_시작시간 : 신청자의 시작시간 */ - CASE WHEN SUBSTR(BGNG_HR, 0,2) < '20' THEN TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(EE.END_HR, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(EE.END_HR, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 END ) * 24, 0 ) AS RET_VAL FROM ( SELECT MM.BGNG_HR , MM.END_HR , DD.WORK_YMD FROM AYC110 MM , AYC100 DD WHERE 1=1 AND MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND DD.USER_ID = #{CHG_TRGT_ID} AND DD.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN <> #{CHG_TRGT_SN} /* 대상_업무일정일렬번호 */ AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(DD.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(MM.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{CHG_DMND_YMD} || REPLACE(#{CHG_DMND_BGNG_HR}, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY DD.WORK_YMD DESC, SUBSTR(MM.BGNG_HR,0,2) DESC ) EE WHERE ROWNUM = 1 UNION ALL /* 대상자이후휴게시간 */ SELECT 'CHG_TRGT_AFTER' AS RET_TITLE , TRUNC( ( TO_DATE(EE.WORK_YMD || SUBSTR(EE.BGNG_HR,1,2) || SUBSTR(EE.BGNG_HR,4,2) , 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') - CASE /* 요청_시작시간 : 신청자의 시작시간 → 요청_종료시간으로 변경 */ WHEN SUBSTR(#{CHG_DMND_BGNG_HR}, 0, 2) < '20' THEN TO_DATE(#{CHG_DMND_YMD} || REPLACE(#{CHG_DMND_END_HR}, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE TO_DATE(#{CHG_DMND_YMD} || REPLACE(#{CHG_DMND_END_HR}, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 END ) * 24, 0 ) AS RET_VAL FROM ( SELECT MM.BGNG_HR , DD.WORK_YMD , DD.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN FROM AYC110 MM , AYC100 DD WHERE 1=1 AND MM.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = DD.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AND DD.USER_ID = #{CHG_TRGT_ID} AND DD.TASKWK_SCHDL_SN <> #{CHG_TRGT_SN} /* 대상_업무일정일렬번호 */ AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(DD.WORK_YMD || REPLACE(MM.BGNG_HR,':','' ), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{CHG_DMND_YMD} || REPLACE(#{CHG_DMND_BGNG_HR}, ':', ''), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ORDER BY DD.WORK_YMD ASC, SUBSTR(MM.BGNG_HR,0,2) ASC ) EE WHERE ROWNUM = 1
